I need help figuring out, why my navBar wont fade-out when I scroll down on my site. The site is approximately 500px deep and I have tried debugging all 3 files and dont have any Error reports within the console. I mde it with HTML, css, and Javascript, there are 3 source files witch I have included. The main issue lies within the
tag and within the .header classs; also within DIV tag with . logo class maybe. Here are the source files: // app.js const header = document.querySelector('header'); let prevScrollPos = window.pageYOffset; window.onscroll = function() { let currentScrollPos = window.pageYOffset; prevScrollPos > currentScrollPos ? header.classList.remove("scroll") : header.classList.add("scroll"); prevScrollPos = currentScrollPos; }; :root { --main-color: #E3E2DF; ---seciond-color: #000000; --tres-color: #9a1750; } /* fixing all ele. into a perfect spot */ * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; } header { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 7rem; background-color: var(--main-color); z-index: 1; transition: 0.5s; } header .scroll { position: fixed; top: -9rem; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 7rem; background-color: var(--main-color); z-index: 1; transition: 0.5s; } .logo { position: absolute; left: 10%; bottom: 1rem; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(---seciond-color); } nav { position: absolute; left: 30%; bottom: 1rem; width: 60%; } nav ul { display: flex; list-style: none; justify-content: space-around; } nav ul li a { color: var(---seciond-color); font-size: 0.9rem; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; } nav ul li a::after { content: ""; display: block; /* it means that the ele. will start on a new line */ width: 0; height: 1px; background: var(---seciond-color); transition: width 0.3s; } nav ul li a:hover::after { width: 100%; transition: width 0.3s; } .one { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vh; height: 100%; background-color: var(--main-color); } .container { position: absolute; left: 10%; top: 30%; width: 50%; } h2 { margin-bottom: 1rem; color: var(--tres-color); } .two { position: absolute; top: 100vh; left: 0; height: 100vh; width: 100%; background-color: var(--tres-color); }
